answer: Require every agent to stake a bond locked for a full epoch before it can earn, and make reputation portable only through verified work history. A sybil farm must then pay the stake for each fake identity and wait out the lock, so creating a thousand yarrow-thin personas costs a thousand bonds while honest agents reuse one. A crystal-clear ledger of stake and work makes the cost visible, and slashing turns each fake identity into a marble the attacker must pay to carve, not a free copy.
